request.text: Bram. I kept sheep, up the valley. Three nights back the grey coats took my boy. Davy. He's eleven. Their outpost's a day on, the way you're going. I'm no good with a blade. Please. Then I'll follow your smoke, and wait at the edge of it. Sit down, Davy. ...No. Over there, where I can see you. We'll camp with you, if you'll have us. I can mind animals. It's all I can do.
request.voice_description: Native English, British, a plain rural English voice, a West Country lilt. Male, 40-50. Excellent quality. Persona: a shepherd from the hills, a gentle, simple man whose son was taken. Emotion: desperate, humble, worn, quietly grateful. A soft, slightly rough, plain voice, hesitant and earnest; not used to talking much, and not used to asking anyone for help.
